### 1 — Scene
A mixed dinner plate with chickpea salad, spinach leaves, sliced breaded meat (likely chicken), yellow rice, broccoli, and a small corn-on-the-cob round.

### 2 — Vessel
A large, rounded rectangular dinner plate, approximately **27 cm across**. Using a 27 cm circular equivalent:
**Area = 3.14 × 13.5² ≈ 572 cm².**
Food on the neighboring plate is excluded.

### 3 — Items
Visible foods are chickpeas mixed with red onion and red pepper/tomato; spinach; breaded chicken slices; yellow rice; broccoli; and corn. A light sheen suggests some dressing on the salad, included in its energy estimate rather than counted as a separate, uncertain amount.

### 4–7 — Area, volume, weight, and energy
Areas below are allocated without double-counting overlapping foods. Heights describe the outer envelope of each pile; bulk density is the only packing adjustment.

| Item | Plate area | Area cm² | Height cm | Gross volume ml | Density g/ml | Weight g | kcal/100 g | Energy kcal |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Chickpea and vegetable salad, lightly dressed | 22% | 126 | 2.5 | 315 | 0.65 | 205 | 150 | 308 |
| Spinach leaves | 30% | 172 | 2.5 | 430 | 0.14 | 60 | 23 | 14 |
| Breaded chicken slices | 15% | 86 | 1.3 | 112 | 0.95 | 106 | 240 | 254 |
| Yellow rice | 10% | 57 | 1.8 | 103 | 0.8 | 82 | 150 | 123 |
| Broccoli | 3% | 17 | 2.5 | 43 | 0.55 | 24 | 35 | 8 |
| Corn round, edible portion* | 5% | 29 | 2.0 | 58 | 0.6 | 35 | 96 | 34 |
| **Total** | **85%** | | | | | **512** | | **741** |

*The corn estimate represents edible kernels; the central cob is excluded from food weight and energy.*

### 8 — Sanity check
About **510 g and 740 kcal** is plausible for this substantially covered dinner plate. The greens occupy considerable space but weigh only about 60 g. The main uncertainty is the identity and preparation of the sliced breaded protein, plus the amount of dressing. A reasonable overall range is **430–610 g and 600–900 kcal**.
